mapper.select: SELECT external_device_id AS device_id, COALESCE(name, '') AS name, COALESCE(model, '') AS model, COALESCE(platform, '') AS platform, COALESCE(app_version, '') AS app_version, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM created_at) AS first_seen, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM last_seen_at) AS last_seen, sync_state::text AS sync_json FROM devices WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND external_device_id IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC

INSERT INTO devices(user_id, external_device_id, device_token_hash, name, platform, model, app_version, sync_state) VALUES ( CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{deviceId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NULL, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), 'Android device'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{platform, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), 'android'), COALESCE(#{model, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), COALESCE(#{appVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), CAST(#{syncState, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} AS jsonb) ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, external_device_id) WHERE external_device_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET name = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.name, ''), devices.name), platform = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.platform, ''), devices.platform), model = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.model, ''), devices.model), app_version = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.app_version, ''), devices.app_version), sync_state = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.sync_state = '{}'::jsonb THEN devices.sync_state ELSE devices.sync_state || EXCLUDED.sync_state END, last_seen_at = now(), revoked_at = NULL RETURNING external_device_id AS device_id, COALESCE(name, '') AS name, COALESCE(model, '') AS model, COALESCE(platform, '') AS platform, COALESCE(app_version, '') AS app_version, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM created_at) AS first_seen, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM last_seen_at) AS last_seen, sync_state::text AS sync_json
mapper.update: UPDATE devices SET revoked_at = now() WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND external_device_id = #{deviceId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND revoked_at IS NULL
